summary: Snail, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting an amendment to its existing at-the-market offering (ATM) program, increasing the capacity by up to $3,660,000 in Class A Common Stock, bringing total available capacity to an undisclosed amount after $4,367,863 in prior sales. The ATM, governed by an agreement with H.C. Wainwright & Co., provides a capital access mechanism but imposes no obligation to sell shares. This is a routine capital markets transaction, not a special situation. The filing includes a legal opinion from Blank Rome LLP. The expansion enhances financial flexibility but does not constitute a standalone transformative event meriting special-situations classification.
